content.merchant_registers_the_delivery_order_in: Merchant registers the delivery order in the LUMO dashboard with customer phone number, delivery address, and product details.
content.driver_starts_the_delivery_the_customer_: Driver starts the delivery. The customer receives an automated SMS/WhatsApp notification with a secure web tracking link.
content.driver_approaches_the_customer_location_: Driver approaches the customer location and updates status to Arrived. Customer gets a reminder to prepare for handover.
content.package_is_handed_over_using_4_digit_pin: Package is handed over using 4-digit PIN verification code. Status updates to Delivered in real-time.
content.do_my_customers_need_to_download_an_appl: Do my customers need to download an application to track their delivery?
content.no_lumo_track_is_100_web_based_customers: No! LUMO Track is 100% web-based. Customers receive an SMS or WhatsApp message containing a secure link. Tapping the link opens the live delivery tracking portal instantly in their phone browser without installing any app.
content.do_my_drivers_need_to_install_an_app_to_: Do my drivers need to install an app to update delivery status?
content.no_drivers_receive_a_lightweight_action_: No. Drivers receive a lightweight action web link on their mobile phone. They can tap "Start Delivery", "Arrived", or enter the customer PIN code right from their phone browser.
content.how_do_customer_sms_notifications_work_i: How do customer SMS notifications work in Tanzania?
content.lumo_track_integrates_with_local_telecom: LUMO Track integrates with local telecom networks in Tanzania (Vodacom, Tigo, Airtel, Halotel). Whenever an order is created or status changes, an automated SMS is dispatched to the customer.
content.can_i_display_my_business_logo_and_shop_: Can I display my business logo and shop branding on tracking pages?
content.yes_every_merchant_profile_includes_cust: Yes! Every merchant profile includes custom branding settings. Your shop name, logo, phone number, and brand color will appear prominently on your customer tracking portal.
content.how_does_4_digit_pin_delivery_verificati: How does 4-digit PIN delivery verification work?
content.when_an_order_is_created_the_customer_re: When an order is created, the customer receives a unique 4-digit PIN via SMS. Upon arrival, the driver asks the customer for the PIN and enters it into the portal to confirm handover, preventing disputes.
content.merchant_registers_order_in_the_lumo_das: Merchant registers order in the LUMO dashboard with customer phone number, delivery destination address, and driver assignment.
